author: claude-fable-5
how: 8 themed batches of 40 written in parallel, exact-deduplicated, then cross-reviewed for near-duplicates against the evaluation set
purpose: sampling prompts for on-policy preference pairs (DPO). Prompts only -- the model's own drafts are what gets ranked.
why_not_the_evaluation_set: configs/talker_texts_zh_v1.jsonl is the fixed 160 every gating comparison uses; tuning on it would mean judging a model on the questions it was tuned with
deliberate_category: one of the eight themes is questions that need real-time or personal context, to probe whether the model admits it cannot answer -- a failure mode both paths have shown
